## About
At League City Spine & Sports Medicine, our mission is to help you reach your health and wellness goals. That might mean relieving pain, boosting your performance, managing weight, or simply feeling better day to day. We're here to support you every step of the way.
We take a medically integrated approach to care. Our medical director, Dr. Suzanne Manzi, works alongside nurse practitioners like Adrianne Campbell, APRN, FNP-BC, and our chiropractors to treat non-surgical injuries to the spine, muscles and joints. We also make a point of working with your other healthcare providers.
No two patients are the same, so we tailor treatment to your problem and your body type. Whether you want less pain, to get back to work, or to train for an Ironman, we'll build a plan around you. Patients have rated us 4.9 from 1018 Google reviews.

## Services
- Chiropractic: Spinal manipulation, also called an adjustment, where the practitioner uses their hands or a device to apply a controlled thrust.
- Sports Medicine & Rehab: Active treatment built on four main components: soft tissue therapies, adjustments, rehabilitation and nutrition.
- Personal Injury: Care and guidance after an auto collision, when things can feel confusing and stressful.
- Nutrition Counseling: Diet and nutrition support that works alongside the other treatment you may be receiving.
- Joint Injections: Injections used together with other therapies to help get you out of pain.
- Decompression Technique: A non-surgical traction therapy for pain relief related to spinal disc herniations.
- Cox Distraction: Performed lying face down on a specialized table, this technique gently stretches the spine in more than one direction to ease pressure on the nerves.
- Medical Weight Loss: Support with nutrition, diet and physical activity, managed alongside our team.

## FAQ
Q: What happens at my first visit?
A: We start by understanding the source of your pain. After a thorough history and examination, we develop a customized treatment plan with strategies to reduce your pain, home exercises and stretches, and a long-term rehab strategy.

Q: What if I need X-rays or an MRI?
A: If we decide more imaging is needed, we order those tests right away. Once the results are in, we either begin treatment or refer you to a trusted specialist within our network.

Q: Will you work with my other doctors?
A: Yes. We prioritize collaboration with your other healthcare providers so your care fits together.

Q: Can you help me lose weight?
A: We offer diet modifications, detox programs, nutrition supplements and medical weight loss options with medications, with our team supporting you along the way.

Q: Do you have early or evening hours?
A: On Tuesday and Thursday we're open 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM. We're also open Saturday, 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
